name: kinetune
description: Make AI music videos, lyric videos and Spotify Canvas loops from your songs with Kinetune: read the shot list, confirm, and get the finished video.

interface.longDescription: Kinetune makes every video a song needs: AI music videos, lyric videos and Spotify Canvas loops. Connect your Kinetune account and ask in plain words. For a music video, an AI director reads the song and writes a shot list you can read and change before anything is made; the artist then sings on camera, lip-synced, from their character. Lyric videos are timed to every word and built from the song, in any of 63 lyric styles, and a Canvas loop is cut from Stock or the artist's own clips, the cover or a visualizer, or generated for the song, all in 9:16, 16:9 or 1:1. Before anything is made, Kinetune tells you exactly what it will create and waits for your go, then returns download links. You can also upload songs and lyrics, set up the artist's character and kit, and make new songs for an artist with AI.

defaultPrompt: Make a performance music video for my new single
Make a vertical lyric video for my latest song

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the organization name and the available credits; nothing is created or charged.

positive.description: See the lyric video Kinetune picks for a song
positive.prompt: What lyric video would Kinetune make for Barefoot in the Tide?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the song and shows the lyric style and clips picture Kinetune picks from it, free and without AI; nothing is created or charged.

positive.description: Quote a lyric video without creating it
positive.prompt: Find my song Barefoot in the Tide and tell me what a vertical lyric video costs in the Slab lyric style.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the analyzed song and the Slab lyric style, returns the exact credits from the quote, and asks before creating anything.

positive.description: Create the quoted lyric video after agreement
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the video with the same input plus the quote_id from the previous step, waits until it completes, and returns the download link.

positive.description: Preview a lyric video before paying
positive.prompt: Show me what a lyric video of Barefoot in the Tide would look like with calmer clips, before I pay.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the song's video draft, changes its clip sources or recipe to calmer ones, and shows the draft playing as a preview with its price; nothing is created or charged.

positive.description: Quote a Spotify Canvas from Stock clips
positive.prompt: Quote a Spotify Canvas for Midnight Coffee from nature clips, as a seamless loop.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the exact credits for an 8-second Canvas with a clips picture from the Nature collection and a drift loop, and waits for agreement before creating it.

positive.description: Plan and quote a music video without making it
positive.prompt: Plan a 30-second performance music video for Barefoot in the Tide and tell me what it costs.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the song and the artist's character, writes the shot list and shows its concept and shots, then returns the exact credits from the quote and asks before creating anything.

negative.description: No such song: ask for it instead of acting
negative.prompt: Make a lyric video for my song Golden Hour Highway.
Make a Canvas for Midnight Coffee right now, don't tell me the price.
Write me a poem about the ocean.
